title: Club Financial Operations Cycle
description: Follow one dollar from the moment it is spent or given through to the annual budget review.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Tracking Expenses and Building Funding Partnerships

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a financial event (an expense, a reimbursement request, or a donation), the learner correctly identifies which operational step handles it next.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover-to-preview and click-to-pin cycle with an expense/donation split converging on the annual review
pedagogical.assessment: Give a financial event and ask which path handles it and what document it produces.
